title: B. Coverage and omission
definition: Every critical unit is represented or explicitly flagged; important units are kept; supplementary detail is dropped only for an allowed reason (filler, duplicate, superseded, meta), and an omission can be told apart from an accident.
questions: Are all critical units represented or explicitly flagged?
Are supplementary details omitted only when appropriate (and only for the four allowed reasons)?
Are omissions distinguishable from accidental missing content?

severity.critical: A critical unit (limitation, requirement, condition, takeaway, decision, action item, open question) is missing and not flagged.
severity.major: An important unit is missing; a duplicate omission names a unit that isn't itself represented.
severity.minor: A supplementary detail is missing without a stated reason.

deterministic: element_present for every element carrying critical knowledge
dataset accounting: every unit cited by knowledge or omittable (validateDataset)
future: unit accounting on generated output — Represented / Intentionally omitted / Needs review (ai.unit-accounting)
model_judge: 'Is anything a practitioner would need missing?' over the whole canvas
human: Reviewer checks the safeToOmit list and the omitted units' reasons

requiredAssertions: element_present for each mandatory element carrying critical knowledge
A future unit-accounting assertion per case
passCriteria: All critical knowledge present (every run); no important unit missing without a reason. A word-count ratio is never a pass criterion.
failCriteria: Any critical unit missing and unflagged on any run.
passExample: A 40-unit article: 33 represented, 6 omitted as duplicates of represented units, 1 filler greeting omitted. The one-line 'does not work for HTML entry pages' caveat is on its card.
failExample: Same article: 38 units represented, but the short caveat is the one left out — high coverage, critical omission.

judgeScale.meaning: All critical content present; some important detail missing.
Everything important present; only filler and duplicates left out.
